messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 60 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: AI agents are rapidly maturing now as open-source frameworks hit production milestones with tripled adoption. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, making tool-calling reliability the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are transitioning from early demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and new observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
